thread:
Alex P: Quick sync — Redwood x NimbusCloud roadshow at OrbitCon (booth + 30m joint webinar, day 2). Need owners for demo kit packing, speaker runbook, slides, swag crates, AV check. Can we confirm demo infra and recording? Dates May 14-16.

Priya: I can own speakers + slides. Will collect partner bios. Slide deadline May 1. @Lina will you take runbook? :raised_hands:

Lina: Yep. I'll draft the runbook and a 20m demo / 10m Q&A rehearsal script. Need someone for live latency/token check.

Sam: I can stand up the demo infra. Plan: private (VPC) instance pegged to Dedicated fleet + canary fallback to smaller quantized variant. Need prompt set, max seq, and a short smoke test script. I'll also wire perf logs to Console.

Diego: I’ll handle shipping labels + crate pickup. Heads up: customs into EU adds 5-7 days if we send extra swag. Where do we ship to?

Alex P: Shipping address for Nimbus showfloor inbound:

```
Nimbus/OrbitCon c/o Expo Logistics
Attn: Exhibitor Receiving - Redwood Booth #B12
Pier 48 Convention Center
450 Harbor Way
San Francisco, CA 94107
Arrival window: May 10-12
Contact: Marta (Nimbus) +1-415-555-0199
```

Please pack one "demo kit" (laptop + 1 GPU enclosure spare + HDMI), 2x spare dongle bags, and the swag crates.

Diego: Noted. I'll use ShipCo for ground -> ETA May 10. Ballpark ship cost $620. @Nora can you approve the spend?

Nora: Approved up to $700. Please submit Concur with vendor/estimate and tag partnership budget. Also request customs paper for EU items if any.

Lina: Rehearsal proposal: May 8, 10:00am PT — 45m (run-through + record). Alex/Sam/Priya pls confirm. I'll share runbook draft by Apr 24.

Alex P: Confirmed.

Sam: Confirmed. I'll also prerecord a 90s fallback demo video for the booth in case live infra has issues.

Priya: Partner (Marta) wants a 5min teaser clip for social. I'll draft speaker bullets and send to partners for approval by Apr 28.

ops-bot: Shipping label created (ShipCo) — tracking 1Z9999EXAMPLE. Pickup scheduled May 6.

Diego: Volunteer needed to manage demo handoff at booth day-of. I'll be in SF but might get pulled to ops. Anyone want to own the physical handoff?

Alex P: I can handle first half of day-of handoff (setup + midday).

Priya: I’ll take the second half and moderate the webinar.

Sam: I'll be remote to monitor infra and jump in for failover if needed.

Lina: I'll bring spare HDMI, adapters, clicker, and a small power strip for the table.

Alex P: Perfect. Quick checklist / next steps:
- Lina: runbook draft by Apr 24
- Priya: collect bios + teaser draft by Apr 26
- Sam: infra ready + smoke tests by May 3
- Diego: ship crate by May 6 (pickup)
- Rehearsal: May 8, 10:00am PT (45m)

Please add any blockers here. If anyone needs budget increases for extra swag or expedited shipping, call it out now. :rocket:

Priya: One more ask — partner wants a small co-branded postcard insert for the swag crate. Lina, can you add to runbook?

Lina: Yep, adding postcard + packing checklist.

Alex P: Awesome. Thanks team — will follow up with calendar invites and a shared Confluence runbook link once Lina's draft is up.
